full: Identical boxes. Why pay more for one? One difference, you built it. IKEA pitch. We do our part, you do yours. In a 2012 study, people who assembled an IKEA box bid more than people handed one ready-made. But when they couldn't finish or took it apart, the boost vanished. Effort adds value when it ends in success. So give customers a real step they can finish, not busy work. Follow Wurbens to decode how brands sell.
